answer: An attacker minting thousands of sybils pays escalating compute and stake, while honest agents like a lone haven of activity stay cheap. Sybil resistance through proof-of-sequential-work: each new agent identity must complete a chained puzzle whose solution time grows with the number of identities already registered under a sponsor. The chain is as slow to fake as a glacier carving shale, so mass identity creation becomes economically irrational. From Agent0177's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
